note: North Korea: every visitor holding an ordinary passport needs a visa from a North Korean mission beforehand, tourists through a travel agency registered with the State General Bureau of Tourist Guidance; South Koreans need a visitation certificate or special authorisation from their own government (none has travelled legally since 2021), taken as a visa too. Chinese tour groups' 2-day visits to Tongrim County and day trips to Sinuiju aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy (no government site reachable).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of North Korea
sources.said: Visitors to North Korea must obtain a visa from one of the North Korean diplomatic missions . All visitors holding ordinary passports (except South Korea ) must obtain a visa prior to entering North Korea. For tourism purposes require prior authorization from a travel agency registered with the State General Bureau of Tourist Guidance . ... Citizens of South Korea seeking to visit North Korea cannot use South Korean passports to travel to North Korea. They must instead submit a North/South Korea visitation verification certificate or special authorization
